import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.screen import Screen

def test_double_width_character_rendering():
    console = Console(width=10, height=5, legacy_windows=False)
    with console.capture() as capture:
        console.print(Screen("あ\nあ"))
    result = capture.get()
    expected = "あ         \nあ         \n"
    assert result == expected
